inputs.text: A vertical outdoor digital portrait photograph of one clearly adult woman seated front-facing on pale gray painted metal stairs, her upper body positioned slightly right of center while her raised knees and white-tighted legs dominate the lower half of the frame. She has fair neutral-toned skin, a softly rounded youthful adult face, large dark eyes looking directly toward the camera, lightly flushed cheeks, a small straight nose, closed peach-toned lips, and a quiet slightly hesitant expression. Her short dense black hair forms a rounded chin-length bob with softly curved ends and uneven wispy bangs spreading across her forehead and partially framing her eyes. She wears a white short-sleeved sailor-style blouse with a broad folded collar edged by narrow pale blue parallel stripes, a small dark embroidered motif at the center of the collar, and a deep navy ribbon tied loosely at the chest. The blouse is tucked into a dark navy pleated skirt with muted blue side panels and long folded fabric sections draping over the step beside her right hip. Her knees are drawn closely together in front of her torso, both lower legs extend downward toward the camera, and her feet rest naturally on the lower step inside opaque white footed tights, with the individual toe contours subtly visible beneath the stretched fabric. Both arms descend between and beside the raised knees, the wrists overlapping near the lower left side of her body, while her relaxed fingers cross loosely and point downward. Her head tilts slightly toward her right shoulder, the shoulders remain gently rounded forward, and the compact seated posture creates natural compression through the waist, skirt, hips, knees, and ankles. A neatly paired set of dark brown polished leather loafers sits on the lower-left step beside her feet, aligned side by side with their toes facing the camera. A pale gray metal railing enters from the lower left and rises diagonally behind her, its evenly spaced vertical bars forming a structured geometric frame around the subject. Dense sunlit green shrubs fill the upper-left and upper-right background, small pink and purple flowers grow in a planter behind the stairs, and modern concrete building beams, white walls, and a shaded passage remain softly visible through the foliage. Bright natural daylight from the upper left and front creates clean highlights across the white blouse, face, knees, and stair surfaces, subtle reflected light beneath the chin and arms, restrained soft shadows between the legs and skirt folds, and small glossy reflections on the loafers and metal railing. integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, live-action, the scene opens from the underwater framing and pose established by Picture 1, showing a young Asian woman suspended vertically beneath the surface of a sunlit swimming pool, wearing a fitted light blue swimsuit with a delicate silver necklace at her collarbone, both arms reaching straight up toward the bright surface, her palms pressed together back-to-back, light blooming between her fingers, and her long dark hair trailing loosely downward in the water. The camera holds a slow, drifting underwater shot as she begins to transition out of the vertical reach: her hands separate and sweep outward in a wide, fluid arc through the water, palms turning to face forward, while her shoulders roll gently backward and her torso tilts forward into a horizontal posture. Her legs, which had been trailing behind her in a long vertical line, swing forward together and extend straight behind her as her body rotates into a head-first swimming position. Streams of small bubbles trail from her moving hands, shoulders, and hair as she reorients, and her hair fans out softly behind her head. She begins a smooth, continuous forward underwater breaststroke: she extends both arms outward in a wide arc and pulls them back toward her hips while her legs bend and kick together in a gentle whip motion, propelling her directly toward the camera. The camera reframes with her into the frontal underwater composition established by Picture 2, where she now glides directly toward the lens with arms extended outward and slightly forward, palms relaxed, bubbles streaming upward around her arms and shoulders, settling into the exact pose, framing, lighting, and composition established by Picture 2 at the end of the shot.

overall_soundscape: A continuous muffled, hushed underwater ambience surrounds the scene throughout. Soft water displacement hisses gently as her arms sweep downward and her body rotates into the swimming posture. Small bubble streams rise and pop softly throughout the motion, with rhythmic water displacement from each arm pull and leg kick. The pool water produces a faint low rumble from distant filtration. No surface sounds or voices are audible.

non_diegetic_music: A slow, ethereal ambient pad at a relaxed tempo, featuring soft synth chords, sustained low strings, and gentle high-register piano tones that swell faintly during the rotation and sustain through the final forward glide.
